original_ledger_title: Hierarchical structure — scene/beat within arc/act within story
reported_scope: U (universal principle, though implementation varies by format)
audit_rationale: Ink knots may contain stitches and Yarn files contain nodes; neither establishes a common Knots→Stitches→Arcs hierarchy across noninteractive scripts. Reported U downgraded to interactive/long narrative only.
independence_qualification: Distinct projects, but both interactive authoring grammars; corroboration not independent evidence of universal benefit.

original_ledger_title: Pacing diagnostics — outcome patterns, sequel counts, length outliers
audit_rationale: All stated diagnostics are source-described, including the crucial qualification that warnings prompt rereading rather than prescribe mandatory thresholds. Source-authentic checklist, not an effectiveness study.
independence_qualification: Single author ecosystem; no independent performance validation.

original_ledger_title: Gather-point convergence as pacing tool
reported_scope: CD (context-dependent — most relevant to branching/complex narratives)
audit_rationale: Gather marks explicitly rejoin branching paths. Source does not test or claim gather points are inherently pacing beats or a resolution mechanism.
independence_qualification: Single interactive design implementation; extension to linear scripts unverified.

original_ledger_title: Setup-payoff tracking with status lifecycle
audit_rationale: Status lifecycle planned→planted→paid-off is supported for promises/clues, but questions use open/answered and motifs/arc hints need no machine-checked payoff. Every setup must pay off is too broad.
independence_qualification: Single source ecosystem; mystery norms not universal to documentary reporting.

original_ledger_title: Delayed significance — reader sees the clue before understanding it
reported_scope: U (mystery, thriller, documentary revelation, nonfiction investigation)
audit_rationale: Exact significance-delayed flag and fair-play condition are documented. Effect on narrative cohesion, transfer to documentaries, and U status are not established.
independence_qualification: Single mystery-writing implementation; no audience experiment.

original_ledger_title: Avoid idioms, culture-specific references, and modifier stacks for international audiences
reported_scope: U (any content intended for multilingual or international audiences)
audit_rationale: Microsoft explicitly discourages idioms/culture references/modifier stacks for globally localized content; Mozilla addresses meaning-based cultural adaptation. Context is localization, not every international creative script.
independence_qualification: Two organizational guides, but overlapping localization tradition and no script-listening tests.

original_ledger_title: Six-level evidence taxonomy for nonfiction
audit_rationale: The source names seven evidence categories including image/video; Claude omitted that category and recast types as a numbered strength hierarchy. Independent corroboration for contested matters is supported.
independence_qualification: One authored derivative workflow based on a nonfiction writing anthology; no empirical evidence of ranking.

original_ledger_title: Four-class source probative taxonomy
audit_rationale: Four labels exist exactly, but the XML prompt is an author-proposed archival relevance classifier, not a calibrated measure of claim-specific evidentiary weight.
independence_qualification: Single program prompt; background Gottschalk provenance not independently verified.

original_ledger_title: Adversarial review — the Dissertation/Opponent model
audit_rationale: An uninvolved colleague opponent and checklist appear verbatim in S27; S09 uses isolated reviewer roles. Claimed actual error reduction vs self-review has not been measured.
independence_qualification: Distinct implementations but S27 draws on S26 ProPublica, which must not count again as independent.

original_ledger_title: Risk flagging — certain topics require human expert review
audit_rationale: S01 demands qualified reviewer for specified risks; S24 escalates when outside competence, and S09 offers editorial specialist tracks, not mandatory human sign-off for every scenario.
independence_qualification: Source authors separate; norms not randomized effectiveness demonstrations.

original_ledger_title: Subject rights — consent, privacy, power imbalance, harm assessment
audit_rationale: Consent, safety, unequal power, anonymity, publication impact, and reporter intervention are directly discussed. This is a risk-assessment practice for nonfiction, not legal clearance.
independence_qualification: S24 is a compiled adaptation; S01 corroborates defamation/consent only, not every subpoint.

original_ledger_title: Interactive narrative — text-first authoring
audit_rationale: Both systems represent authored dialogue and branch mechanics, but asserting mechanics are never visible and dialogue/text is universally the default is stronger than specifications prove.
independence_qualification: Two separate implementations in one interactive-narrative field.

original_ledger_title: Three-dimensional prose rating — novelty, clarity, prose quality
audit_rationale: S03 explicitly defines A–F novelty, clarity, and prose ratings, with overall grade the lowest. Accurate description of a single author heuristic, not independently validated quality measurement.
independence_qualification: Single author-prompt, no validation experiment.

original_ledger_title: LLM writing anti-patterns — measurable dimensions
reported_scope: U (detecting and avoiding AI writing patterns)
audit_rationale: Repo compares repeated outputs of sampled LLMs and does not establish general lower burstiness/lexical diversity versus human-authored matched baselines. Recast as LLM-internal observations only.
independence_qualification: Single small study (10 runs per model); changing model cohorts and metrics limit transfer.

original_ledger_title: 15-question story evaluation rubric
audit_rationale: Original code and README directly contain a 15-question story rating rubric; neither proves usefulness, human agreement, or predictive audience quality.
independence_qualification: One evaluation dataset and rubric, no external replication found.

original_ledger_title: Long-form coherence — segments must compose seamlessly
audit_rationale: Incremental updating and hierarchical merging explicitly concern book summarization methods. Generalizing to original documentary series coherence requires separate evidence.
independence_qualification: S41 shares researchers with S42; not two independent studies.

original_ledger_title: Faithfulness errors concentrate in events and character states
audit_rationale: FABLES repo confirms annotated claims in book-length LLM summaries, but this inspected README does not establish the claimed frequency of event/state errors versus facts or the recency-bias assertion. Must inspect primary paper/results.
independence_qualification: S42 linked to BooookScore; not independent of S41.

original_ledger_title: Trust the reader — don't explain what they can infer
audit_rationale: Trust-the-reader inference/ambiguity principle is stated directly, but recommended fiction practice is not measured for all narrative/nonfiction audiences.
independence_qualification: Single creative-writing skill author; claimed linked research not independently audited.

original_ledger_title: Modular scenes — reusable narrative units
reported_scope: CD (context-dependent — most relevant to series, recurring formats)
audit_rationale: Ink tunnels operate as callable sub-story routines; reusability is technically supported, but transferring that architecture into linear series is an analogy, not source evidence.
independence_qualification: One implementation of interactive flow controls.

original_ledger_title: Separation of research/writing from review/verification
audit_rationale: Opponent reviewer in S27 is genuinely uninvolved; S09 allows limited independence via isolated role passes when agents unavailable. Absolute requirement for a different human/agent overstates guides.
independence_qualification: S27 acknowledges S26 inspiration, so four cited sources are not four independent confirmations.

original_ledger_title: Assertions must not exceed evidence strength
audit_rationale: Traceable source tiers and explicit unknowns are documented; a universal claim about correlation/causation is not demonstrated by these inspected passages.
independence_qualification: Separate research/editorial guidance but not experiments; S24 is derivative.

original_ledger_title: Genre/format conventions are checkable rules, not universal mandates
audit_rationale: Genre-specific constraints occur in S01; cross-genre principle is plausible but the stated requirement to record all deliberate deviations lacks collective support.
independence_qualification: Much of cited craft shares published upstream frameworks.

original_ledger_title: Classic style as default for spoken delivery
audit_rationale: S03 does specify 9th-grade and 8–16-word conversational summaries; these are task-specific prompt settings, not established universal norms for spoken narration.
independence_qualification: S03 is not separate corroboration for itself; Microsoft is corporate localization guidance.

original_ledger_title: Anti-hallucination protocols for AI-assisted writing
audit_rationale: S05 defines outline-is-law and [INVENTED] tagging inside its novel drafting workflow. S01/S08 call for no unsupported factual additions. The single full three-law protocol does not independently generalize to all AI writing.
independence_qualification: S05 own framework; S01/S08 address other settings; no three independent identical protocols.

original_ledger_title: Continuity review across four domains
audit_rationale: S02 directly enumerates four consistency dimensions. S08 scene state and S53 cross-branch variables are not independent confirmation that this four-part rubric governs every script genre.
independence_qualification: Specialized fiction, explainers and interactive-game tools; no universal test.

original_ledger_title: Three empirically documented LLM prose failure modes
audit_rationale: S02 attributes syntactic and attractor-state patterns to external studies, but stock physical tells are craft diagnosis rather than a separately demonstrated experiment. Original papers were not independently verified in this GitHub-only pass.
independence_qualification: Shared single source and linked papers, not three original experimental confirmations.

original_ledger_title: Evidence hierarchy for AI writing antipatterns
audit_rationale: Evidence-quality tiers are author synthesis; specific named features lack individual validation shown by these repo files.
independence_qualification: Same author ecosystem as F-161, and citations to external studies are secondary evidence until read.

original_ledger_title: Semantic unit extraction before visual design — 7-type communicative function taxonomy
audit_rationale: Original source requires semantic units and sourced explanatory roles; schema explicitly enumerates all seven communicative functions. Source-authentic method limited to educational video visual systems.
independence_qualification: Single skill and schema; no experiment on comprehension.

original_ledger_title: All readability formulas were normed on written text reading — none validated for listening
reported_scope: U (universal caution for any script quality measurement)
audit_rationale: Tools plainly compute written-text readability measures; they do not furnish historical proof that EVERY listed formula was normed only on silent reading or cannot be validated for listening. Needs original psychometric history and audio studies.
independence_qualification: Repositories are implementations, not independent empirical validation of the universal negative.

original_ledger_title: No existing text metrics measure the dimensions most critical for script quality
audit_rationale: The three selected NLP tools do not claim to exhaust all possible text/voice measurements; assertion that NONE measure listed dimensions and that a particular metric is most applicable is unsupported by source scope.
independence_qualification: Absence from a tool cannot prove absence across the full measurement literature.

original_ledger_title: Revelations as the engine of plot — target 7–10 major reveals
audit_rationale: Exact revelation advice and 7–10 minimum appear in the Truby-derived skill. No controlled justification for numeric minimum or adaptation to documentary scripts.
independence_qualification: Derivative John Truby methodology; S55 is not an independent theory origin.

original_ledger_title: Forge Point convergence crises — all narrative strands in simultaneous crisis
audit_rationale: All-three-strands-in-crisis requirement accurately describes S05 Crucible-specific model, not a validated prerequisite for effective fiction.
independence_qualification: One original framework, no test or independent corroboration.

original_ledger_title: Mercy Engine — victory through consequences of mercy, not power
reported_scope: NS (epic fantasy, long-form fiction with moral themes)
audit_rationale: S05 explicitly mandates four costly mercies culminating in victory within Crucible structure; should not become a universal moral narrative rule.
independence_qualification: Same S05 framework as F-211, not independent.

original_ledger_title: Dark Mirror antagonist — parallel origin, comprehensible divergence, kernel of truth
audit_rationale: S05 requires parallel origin, divergence and partial-truth antagonist. S55 describes a Truby-style opposition web, not independent proof the S05 Dark Mirror is most effective.
independence_qualification: Different authored skills draw on existing antagonist craft; shared lineage unresolved.

original_ledger_title: Four-corner opposition — characters as different approaches to the central moral problem
audit_rationale: Four-corner opposition directly described by S55 with Truby attribution; a selectable fiction framework, not a universal efficacy finding.
independence_qualification: Truby-derived; independent empirical evidence absent.
